posts.title: Linux Saloon 228 | Open Mic Night, AI Tools Discussion
posts.description: This Linux Saloon episode features Michael “Vash” demonstrating Emacslisten, a collection of packages for controlling Emacs through local voice commands and dictation. The discussion covers transcription tools, speaker diarization, AI’s benefits and risks, local versus frontier models, and practical applications. The show also includes community comments, project links, and upcoming Open Mic Night

posts.title: Linux Saloon 227 | Devario OS
posts.description: The Linux Saloon episode features PapalPenguin’s return after several years, discussing his new Skytech gaming PC running CachyOS and Mass Effect. It also covers Devario OS, Linux power management, system tools, community projects, and participant resources. Next week’s event is Open Mic Night, with listeners invited to submit suggestions via email, Telegram, or Discord.

posts.title: Linux Saloon 226 | News Flight Early Edition
posts.description: The content discusses various tech topics, including Shykle's work on TPM encryption with Ubuntu and news about a significant code-execution flaw affecting servers globally. Additionally, updates on Fortnite's introduction to Linux and Canonical's accelerated development of Ubuntu Core Desktop are highlighted, along with links to community projects and suggestions for content.
